svg.title: Research interests
svg.desc: Research interests: Urban Science, Embodied AI, Robotic Urbanization, Multimodal Urban Sensing, Digital Twins. I study embodied intelligence in urban systems, with a focus on human-robot interaction, spatial intelligence, and the urban deployment and governance of robots.

spatial intelligence, and the urban deployment and governance of robots.
